transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the S-4 Logistics Officer. I'll be finalizing today's issue board for the four diagnostic kits -- FT-2, TL-1, LT-4, and BA-3 -- which need to be matched to our four routine work orders: communications-cable certification, clinic-generator inspection, aviation ground-power inspection, and motor-pool battery audit. Who's ready to start?
